 Famous Korean Fried Chicken Chain To Open At VivoCity With Free Boneless Chicken
 19th November 2026 
 Follow us on Whatsapp 
 for the latest updates 
 Follow us on Telegram 
 for the latest updates 
 Facebook Twitter 
 BB.Q Chicken Singapore opens at VivoCity’s Food Republic
 Image credit: Hiro Nonoda via Google Maps 
 Calling all K-drama and Stray Kids fans: the chicken Felix keeps talking about is opening near you. BB.Q Chicken , which says it’s the world’s biggest Korean fried chicken chain, is set to open a food court stall at Food Republic , VivoCity on 27 November 2026 . Two more outlets will follow over the next couple of months.
 17 Korean Fried Chicken In Singapore, Including Hawker And Halal Options 
 The VivoCity stall is a BB.Q Chicken Express, a smaller grab-and-go version of the brand. Next, another stall will open at Food Opera, ION Orchard in December 2026 . Then a second BB.Q Chicken Express opens at Food Junction, Junction 8 in January 2027 , which is good news for Bishan folks who’d rather not trek to HarbourFront for a chicken fix.
 Image credit: BB.Q Chicken 
 If the name sounds familiar, you may have spotted it on screen. The chain has turned up in K-dramas such as Crash Landing on You and Guardian: The Lonely and Great God , better known as Goblin , and in variety shows Running Man and Knowing Bros .
 Image credit: @felix.lee.00 
 It started in Korea in 1995, and the name stands for “Best of the Best Quality.” Today it has about 4,500 stores across 57 countries. It even has its own training school for franchisees, Chicken University, which has been running since 1999. Stray Kids member Felix was also a fan long before he became the brand’s global ambassador.
 Image credit: Raymond Fu via Google Maps 
 The full Singapore menu and prices haven’t been released, but two signatures are confirmed for the VivoCity launch. Soy Garlic Chicken (price TBD) comes coated in a sweet-savoury soy glaze with plenty of garlic, the go-to pick if you don’t do spice. Heat-seekers should get the Red Chak Chak Seasoning Chicken (price TBD) , coated in a spicy red pepper seasoning instead of a sauce. From the opening promos, expect combos, boneless chicken, bone-in chicken, and burgers on the menu too.
 Image credit: Ivonne Rivera via Google Maps 
 Now for the freebies. From 3 December to 17 December 2026 , every order comes with a free two-piece boneless chicken; orders of sides alone don’t qualify. The outlet picks the flavour, so there’s no choosing.
 Felix fans get their own perk from 3 December 2026 . Buy any two items from the combo, boneless chicken, or bone-in chicken categories, or the burger category, and you’ll get a sealed surprise pack with two Felix photocards and one photo strip. There are four photocard designs and two photo strip designs, so collecting the full set could take a few visits.
 Can’t wait till the 27th? Read our Lotteria review for another popular Korean fast food chain that’s recently set up shop in Singapore! Otherwise, read our guide to the best 1-for-1 buffet deals for 2026 for more affordable eats.
 Address:  1 HarbourFront Walk, #03-01, Food Republic, VivoCity, Singapore 098585
Opening hours: TBD
 Website 
BB.Q Chicken is not halal-certified.
